newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Slightly easier European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Slightly easier European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market opened quietly this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets between $5 lower for nearby material to $1 up for more distant positions, following last night's Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were offered unchanged to $1 lower. No trades were reported during the early stages of the market.

"Despite the slightly easier seller prices there was little buying interest, mainly due to strong dollar. No bids were reported this morning and it looks like we are heading for another dull day," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 045832
